content.short: M1 Capital provides exposure to digital assets, staking, and arbitrage strategies.
content.description: M1 Capital has developed two funds. The first fund provides investors with a clear path to gain strategic exposure to the digital asset space while earning staking yields, blending potential growth with staking income. The second fund seeks market-neutral returns in the digital asset markets by employing multiple arbitrage trading strategies, with the aim of mitigating directional risk while pursuing opportunities across price relationships within crypto assets.
